scenarios.name: A creature with power 2 or less cannot block Questing Beast
scenarios.ruling: The blocking restriction is checked as blockers are declared, so a 2/2 is not a legal blocker and the damage goes through.

scenarios.name: A creature with power 3 can block Questing Beast and dies to deathtouch
scenarios.ruling: Only creatures with power 2 or less are stopped; a 3/3 blocks legally and any damage from a deathtouch source is lethal.

scenarios.name: Haste lets Questing Beast attack the turn it enters
scenarios.ruling: A creature with haste can attack even though its controller has not controlled it continuously since their most recent turn began.

scenarios.name: Vigilance keeps Questing Beast untapped after it attacks
scenarios.ruling: Attacking does not cause a creature with vigilance to tap.

scenarios.name: Fog cannot prevent combat damage from creatures you control
scenarios.ruling: Questing Beast's third ability stops prevention effects, so a Fog cast before combat prevents nothing dealt by any creature Questing Beast's controller controls.

scenarios.name: Combat damage to an opponent is echoed onto a planeswalker they control
scenarios.ruling: The trigger deals the same amount of damage to the targeted planeswalker; four damage removes all three loyalty counters from Jace Beleren.
